prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high fidelity native macOS desktop app interface concept, landscape 16:10, one complete application window. LAB is a refined physical-product design app. Keep consistent shared visual language: warm ivory #F7F6F2, dark charcoal #292D2B, muted sage secondary labels, tiny rust #C96543 accent, understated SF Pro-like sans serif controls, elegant restrained serif page title, thin gray rules, generous spacing, softly rounded native controls. Mac traffic lights upper left, project name 'STILL / Botanical care', top center same primary navigation 'Form  Function  Fabricate' and a small secondary aperture icon for Studio. Crisp readable typography and plausible controls. No purple gradients, no decorative dashboards, no oversized marketing headings. This is a usable professional application. Preserve coherent typography/style while the working layouts differ. Primary request: Function environment selected. A construction engineering bench for a paper cosmetics tuck carton. Left narrow component tree with Front, Back, Sides, Dust flaps, Glue seam. Main broad pale technical stage shows an attractive white carton partially unfolded with dimension leader lines and gold crease guides; a smaller complete flat dieline inset gives context. Right medium property rail shows Construction dimensions, Internal width 64 mm, Height 138 mm, Depth 38 mm, Board thickness 0.45 mm, Clearances; fold slider and Opening slider; identified Glue seam relationship. Bottom construction review strip with clear check icons and one stock assumption. Title 'Understand the construction'. This layout should feel technical and spatial, substantially different from a drawing canvas and a production wizard. Beautiful designed mockup, detail legibility.
